title: A message drives one turn to TASK_STATE_COMPLETED
rationale: The baseline shape of every A2A interaction with Nexus: one client message becomes one task that moves SUBMITTED -> WORKING -> COMPLETED, and the turn's answer arrives as an ARTIFACT rather than as a message, because A2A puts task output in artifacts (specification section 3.7). The assert_active step between the model's text and the end of the turn pins the deviation that matters most here: the task completes when the AGENT TURN ends, not when the model produced its last token. Nexus publishes output and runs its output gates between those two moments, so a mapping that completed at the model response would publish the model's draft instead of what Nexus decided to say.

steps.note: the raw model response must NOT complete the task; the output gates have not run yet
